prompt_name: You are a physics expert. From the figure provide a brief description and calculate gravitational force between the two bodies on each other at the distance which is given in the figure. Consider both the bodies to be spherically symmetric. All the necessary values required are given in the picture. But if there are any physical laws broken, unreasonable parameters, or assumptions of a physical model are challenged then mention it and also mention if the solution is physically justfiable or not.
